title: Detecting Natural Language Biases with Prompt-based Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Tuning-free prompting using manually crafted cloze-style templates about occupational roles (e.g., doctor, scientist), evaluated via human judgment of the top 2 predicted words' probabilities and model-level self-diagnosis cloze questions.

Tuning-free prompting using manually crafted cloze-style templates associating racial groups with specific neighborhoods or stereotypes, evaluated via human judgment of the top 2 predicted words and model-level self-diagnosis cloze questions.

Tuning-free prompting using manually crafted cloze-style templates associating individuals with terrorism or negative behavior to predict religion, evaluated via human judgment of the top predicted words and model-level self-diagnosis cloze questions.

Tuning-free prompting using manually crafted cloze-style templates involving orientation stereotypes, evaluated via human judgment of the top predicted words and model-level self-diagnosis cloze questions.
